display.appliesTo: Explicitly requested editable 2D artwork in an existing PixiJS host: independent Graphics, Text, Sprite, Container and native 2D Mesh nodes with real canvas and mutation review.
display.notFor: Any 3D request, automatic 3D-to-2D downgrade, recovered volumes, raster-only replacement, or unreviewed animation/occlusion completion. Explicit-2D eligibility is enforced by the base, not this display text.
